fit: Frozen source128 features; inherit source-only original mean/scale and lambda unchanged. Per output fixed delta =1.35*max(median(abs(r-median(r)))/.6744897501960817,1e-4), r from original ridge source residual. Minimize weighted Huber +lambda/2 norm(coef)^2, intercept unpenalized. No re-estimated scale or target selection.
optimizer: Per output L-BFGS-B starts original ridge; gtol1e-10 ftol1e-15 maxiter2000 maxls50. Require sup gradient<=1e-7 before any evaluation. One-step control fits weighted ridge once with original residual weights; shuffled control permutes converged Huber influence weights within source(user,trueclass) cells per output using SeedSequence([seed,held,output,user,class]); fit weighted ridge once. Neither weight set is renormalized.
scope: six reused source development folds, not independent test, not novel method
stop: If numerical or effect gate fails, no eightfold expansion and no threshold/scale/lambda/seed grid or control promotion.
limitations: Residual outlier status is not evidence of wrong labels; easy/rare class suppression is possible.
Derivative with respect to residual is bounded; full parameter influence may remain large for high-leverage features.
Encoder trained on all source clips and frozen; source fitting weights cannot undo encoder influence.
This fixed-scale multioutput application is not sklearn concomitant-scale HuberRegressor or replication of a radar paper.
Fixed-lambda loss comparison is not an independently tuned robust-regression optimum.
